llm_calls_nonnegative.name: llm_calls_nonnegative
llm_calls_nonnegative.value: "llm_calls"."attempt" > 0 AND "llm_calls"."reserved_input" >= 0 AND "llm_calls"."reserved_output" >= 0 AND "llm_calls"."reserved_ms" >= 0 AND ("llm_calls"."input_tokens" IS NULL OR "llm_calls"."input_tokens" >= 0) AND ("llm_calls"."output_tokens" IS NULL OR "llm_calls"."output_tokens" >= 0) AND ("llm_calls"."latency_ms" IS NULL OR "llm_calls"."latency_ms" >= 0)

question_aliases_exposure.name: question_aliases_exposure
question_aliases_exposure.value: ("question_aliases"."status" = 'matched' AND "question_aliases"."exposure_key" IS NOT NULL) OR ("question_aliases"."status" != 'matched' AND "question_aliases"."exposure_key" IS NULL)

topic_cards_versions.name: topic_cards_versions
topic_cards_versions.value: "topic_cards"."content_version" >= 0 AND "topic_cards"."question_version" > 0 AND ("topic_cards"."last_checked_version" IS NULL OR "topic_cards"."last_checked_version" BETWEEN 0 AND "topic_cards"."content_version")
